plain_takeaway: Oct-Dec freezing degree-days changed by about +15 C-days per decade (95% CI -108 to +111). Not statistically distinguishable from no change in this 24-winter record; that is not proof of no change. NASA reanalysis, not an observation; see docs/TEMPERATURE_BIAS_DIAGNOSIS.md.

Mid-winter thaw days: no trend estimated (status mostly_tied). The daily mean is above 0 C on very few days in 2001-2024 in NASA reanalysis, and the reanalysis runs colder than the Yellowknife station, so zero NASA thaw days does not mean no thaw.
